source_text.body:
Flag fees and script calls to negotiate lower bills
A commenter pastes itemized bills or renewal notices into ChatGPT to flag fixed fees and draft a call script for asking for a retention offer.
·
Nov 17, 2026
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
The commenter says they paste an itemized bill or renewal notice into ChatGPT and ask it to flag every line that is not a fixed fee. Then they have it draft a phone script to ask the provider for a retention offer, which they use for bills like phone, internet, and insurance renewals where first-year pricing often expires.
How it went
They do not give a dollar amount or a finished negotiation result, only that these categories are where the savings can add up because providers often raise prices after the first year.
Worth knowing
The main catch is specificity: the thread says vague questions lead to vague answers, so the prompt needs the full bill or renewal notice and a clear request.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Here is my itemized [phone/internet/insurance] bill or renewal notice: [paste text]. Flag any fixed fees, add-ons, or charges that look negotiable or avoidable, and note which ones likely can't be changed. Then write a short phone script for asking for a retention offer or lower rate, including what to say if they refuse and which specific line items to bring up. Finish with the top three asks ranked by likely savings.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1xyh573/how_has_chatgpt_saved_you_money
